name: Brave Search
description: Independent web search via the Brave Search API (https://brave.com/search/api/), exposed as one declarative HTTP tool. Provides the swappable `web.search` layer, so selecting it in the layer picker re-points the stable `web__search` tool at Brave's own crawled index without changing what agents call. Brave is search-only: it deliberately declares neither `web.extract` nor `web.crawl`. Requires a BYOK Brave Search API key.
tagline: Search an index nobody else syndicates

config.description: Web search over Brave's own independent index. Returns ranked results with titles, URLs, and description snippets. This is a GET endpoint, so every argument is sent as a query parameter. Requires RYU_BRAVE_API_KEY.

q.description: The search query. Brave accepts at most 400 characters and 50 words.

count.description: Results per page. Brave's own maximum is 20, which is also its default.

country.description: Two-letter country code to target results at (Brave defaults to US).

search_lang.description: Language code to filter result content by (Brave defaults to en).

freshness.description: Restrict results by age: pd (past 24h), pw (past 7 days), pm (past 31 days), py (past year), or an explicit YYYY-MM-DDtoYYYY-MM-DD range.

fields.label: Brave Search subscription token
fields.description: Create a subscription token at https://api-dashboard.search.brave.com/app/keys and paste it here. Stored encrypted on this node and never shown again — re-paste to change it. Without a token the Brave tool stays installed but returns nothing, so `web.search` falls back to whichever other provider you select.
